name: TWL
recent: TWL 将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日召开特别股东大会，寻求股东批准追认向主席妻子 Datin Sek Chian Nee 授予的 ESOS 期权。近期董事及大股东（Dato' Tan Wei Lian、Datin Sek、TWL Capital）密集申报股权变动，同时公司因 RCULS 转换发行 154 万股新股。最新财报显示营收同比大增但净利同比大幅下滑。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日召开特别股东大会，寻求追认向 Datin Sek Chian Nee 授予的 6,600 万份及 5,370 万份 ESOS 期权。
因 RCULS 转换发行 1,540,000 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.03，上市日期为 2026 年 11 月 16 日。
董事 Dato' Tan Wei Lian 及大股东 Datin Sek Chian Nee、TWL Capital Berhad 在 11 月 5 日至 13 日期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: ESOS 期权授予给主席妻子（关联方）未事先获得股东批准，现寻求追认。
RCULS 转换持续发行新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
最新季度净利同比下滑 92.3%，净利率从 17.0% 降至 2.9%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 62,692,000，环比增长 192.6%，同比增长 205.4%；净利为 MYR 1,831,000，环比下降 49.8%，同比下降 92.3%；净利率为 2.9%，低于上一季度的 17.0%。

recent_en: There have been frequent disclosures of changes in interests by directors and substantial shareholders (Dato' Tan Wei Lian, Datin Sek, TWL Capital), and the company issued 1.54 million new shares from RCULS conversion. Latest earnings show a sharp year-on-year revenue increase but a significant decline in net profit.
notable_en: An EGM will be held on 8 Dec 2026 to seek ratification of 66 million and 53.7 million ESOS options granted to Datin Sek Chian Nee.
Issued 1,540,000 new shares from RCULS conversion at RM0.03 per share, with listing date on 16 Nov 2026.
Director Dato' Tan Wei Lian and substantial shareholders Datin Sek Chian Nee and TWL Capital Berhad made multiple disclosures of changes in interests between 5 and 13 November.
risks_en: ESOS options were granted to the chairman's wife (a related party) without prior shareholder approval and are now subject to ratification.
Ongoing new share issuance from RCULS conversion may dilute existing shareholders.
Latest quarterly net profit fell 92.3% year-on-year, with net margin dropping from 17.0% to 2.9%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 62,692,000, up 192.6% QoQ and 205.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 1,831,000, down 49.8% QoQ and 92.3% YoY; net margin was 2.9%, lower than 17.0% in the previous quarter.
